roles.intro: The role hierarchy currently in effect in Kompast — not a configurable permission matrix, just a summary of the rules already in the code.

superAdmin.name: Super Admin
superAdmin.desc: Can create new teams and manage any team (member.isSuperAdmin). Transferring this role revokes it from the previous holder.

workspaceOwner.name: Workspace Owner / Admin
workspaceOwner.desc: Can open Settings (Entra/AI/Email integrations) and invite/manage workspace members (member.role).

teamAdmin.name: Team Admin
teamAdmin.desc: Can create projects within their own team and manage that team's membership (team_member.role). Has no rights in other teams or workspace-wide.

teamMember.name: Team Member
teamMember.desc: A regular member of a team, with no management rights.

projectRole.name: Project Lead / Contributor / Viewer
projectRole.desc: A role that can be assigned per project (project_member.role). Not enforced anywhere in the code yet — it can currently only be assigned.
